Container.Name: rct-manager
Container.Overview:
Bring your RCT Power inverters into one self-hosted dashboard. See live readings, use the Energy Manager with spot prices and solar forecasts, and automate through the REST API.
Battery writes stay off until you enable and verify them. Export metrics to InfluxDB 2 or QuestDB, or scrape the Prometheus endpoint.
Set a persistent HMAC_SECRET before installing. Get the one-time admin password from the container log and change it at first login. HTTP is exposed to your LAN; use a TLS reverse proxy for access from untrusted networks.
Container.Changes: Updated the Unraid template with a one-minute shutdown grace period, current first-login guidance and a documentation link.

Config.Name: HMAC Secret
Config.Description: REQUIRED: Encrypts the administration database (data/rct.db). Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32. Changing it afterwards makes the database unreadable - back it up together with the data volume.

Config.Name: Bind Address
Config.Description: Listen address inside the container. Leave at 0.0.0.0 so the published port reaches the service; a loopback value makes the container unreachable through the port mapping.

Config.Name: Bind Port
Config.Description: Listen port inside the container. Must match the container port in the WebUI/Port mapping below.

Config.Name: Allow Non-Loopback Bind
Config.Description: Explicit consent for a non-loopback listener inside the container. Does not provide TLS; terminate TLS at a reverse proxy and enable 'behind reverse proxy' on the admin Settings page.

Config.Name: Public API Docs
Config.Description: true: serve /docs and /openapi.json without a token. false: both return 404 on every bind address.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: HTTP Web UI/API port, reachable from your LAN. Use a TLS reverse proxy before access from untrusted networks.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Encrypted administration database, dispatch state and settings. Back up together with HMAC_SECRET.
